title: Allow Selected Traffic Through Default Deny
prompt:
Namespace `cka-netpol` has a `default-deny` NetworkPolicy that blocks all ingress and egress. The Pod `client` must reach `api-svc` (backing Pods labeled `app=api` on port `80`) and must still resolve cluster DNS, while the Pod `intruder` must remain unable to reach the API.

Perform the following tasks:
1. Create a NetworkPolicy named `allow-client-api` that allows `client` to reach the `api` Pods on port `80`.
2. Allow DNS egress from `client` to the `kube-system` namespace on UDP and TCP port `53`.
3. Keep `intruder` blocked from reaching the API.

manifests:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny
  namespace: cka-netpol
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: cka-netpol
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: api
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: api
        image: nginx:1.27-alpine
        ports:
        - containerPort: 80
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: api-svc
  namespace: cka-netpol
spec:
  selector:
    app: api
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 80
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: client
  namespace: cka-netpol
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: client
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: client
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: client
        image: curlimages/curl:8.10.1
        command: ["sleep", "3600"]
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: intruder
  namespace: cka-netpol
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: intruder
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: intruder
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: intruder
        image: curlimages/curl:8.10.1
        command: ["sleep", "3600"]

checks.failure_hint: Allow ingress to app=api from app=client on port 80 and egress from client to the API.
Allow egress from client to kube-system on UDP/TCP 53.
Create the policy with exactly that name.
Do not allow app=intruder — the default deny must keep it blocked.

manifests:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-client-api
  namespace: cka-netpol
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: api
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: client
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-client-dns
  namespace: cka-netpol
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: client
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          kubernetes.io/metadata.name: kube-system
    ports:
    - protocol: UDP
      port: 53
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 53
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: api
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80

reference_solution:
Add the allow policies alongside the default deny.
```yaml
# allow-client-api: podSelector app=api, ingress from app=client on 80
# allow-client-dns: podSelector app=client, egress to kube-system UDP/TCP 53 + to app=api:80
```
hints: Inspect existing NetworkPolicies in `cka-netpol` (`k -n cka-netpol describe netpol`) and check both Ingress and Egress isolation.
Allow TCP port 80 between the required client/backend pods AND allow UDP/TCP port 53 egress so CoreDNS resolution succeeds.
